clauses.quote: the employee and the WTU shall be so notified in writing of the modification.
The disciplinary action or disciplinary discharge shall not take effect until the requirements of this article are satisfied.
clauses.subject_text: The disciplinary action or disciplinary discharge

clauses.quote: All suspensions shall be administered in a manner which causes the Teacher to lose no more pay than the actual days of suspension.
The initiation of the disciplinary action shall be taken no later than forty-five (45) school days after the Supervisor’s knowledge of the alleged infraction.
clauses.subject_text: The initiation of the disciplinary action

clauses.quote: any investigation conducted by or on behalf of DCPS into the alleged infraction shall be completed, with any investigation report provided to the employee involved and to the WTU within forty-five (45) days after the Supervisor’s knowledge of the alleged infraction.
clauses.subject_text: any investigation conducted by or on behalf of DCPS into the alleged infraction

clauses.quote: This time limit may be extended by mutual consent
if not so extended, must be strictly adhered to.
clauses.notes: Subject omitted in source text; refers to preceding time limit.

clauses.quote: the employee may be placed immediately on administrative leave pending further administrative action.
clauses.notes: Implies management discretion to place on leave for safety/administrative reasons.

clauses.quote: Teachers may not be suspended on non-school days.
Any Teacher has the right, upon request, to be represented at any disciplinary conference.
The Teacher shall be notified in advance of said administrative conference.
A WTU representative may accompany the Teacher to said conference
may speak on behalf of the Teacher upon the Teacher’s request.

clauses.quote: the Supervisor shall immediately notify the affected Teacher and the WTU Building Representative that an allegation of corporal punishment has been made.
